placedBecause: a campaign instrument that runs as its own process
armedBy: Two mutations to the regex on a scratch copy of reckon.py, one per direction. Loosening it to the pre-fix shape \A([^-]+-[^-]+)\b makes '03-menu' score as an id and reds the refusal check alone. Tightening it to \A([A-Za-z]{4,}-\d{2,})\b makes SCR-0075 unreadable and reds the reads-a-real-id check alone. Neither mutation reds the other check, so the two directions are separately watched rather than one predicate reported twice.
